title: Cursors and Concurrency
description: Process rows one at a time with cursors. Understand deadlocks, how they occur, and strategies to avoid them in production systems.
whatYouLearn: How cursors work and the full life cycle: DECLARE, OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE, DEALLOCATE
Why cursors are almost always slower than set-based alternatives
How deadlocks occur when two transactions lock resources in conflicting orders
Strategies to prevent and resolve deadlocks in production databases
